This cookie allows you to cast the Blade Barrier spell. | notes = |Category1 = Festivult potions |Category2 = Festivult loot }} == 2013 == {{Consumable | picdesc = Lord of Blades Cookie (2013).png | acquired = [[Jester of Festivult]] | location = [[The Harbor]], [[House Deneith]], [[House Jorasco]], [[House Kundarak]], [[House Phiarlan]] | turnin = | minlevel = 1 | bind = {{Bind|No}} | effect = Slayer Boost 25%, Duration: 1 hour (CL: 15) | durability = 5 | material = Flesh | hardness = 0 | cost = 5 pp | weight = 0.01 lbs | description = Gingerbread cookie baked into the shape of the Lord of Blades.
This cookie boosts the amount of kills you get toward slayer quests in adventures areas by 25%. With this effect, for every four kills you make, you get credit for one additional kill.
The effect last for 1 hour. The timer for this effect pauses while you are in public areas or logged out and also pauses while you are in quests.

This cookie boosts the amount of kills you get toward slayer quests in adventures areas by 10%. With this effect, for every ten kills you make, you get credit for one additional kill.
The effect last for 30 minutes. The timer for this effect pauses while you are in public areas or logged out and also pauses while you are in quests.
